summary: Iter 59 — Two-part Realm update verified end-to-end (backend + frontend) against https://realm-deploy.preview.emergentagent.com as stealth/Password1$. PART 1 (Realm widget registry + Hub): GET /api/widgets/available?placement=realm returns exactly 17 widgets with keys = [blog, calendar, countdown, events, hub, live, music, myfeed, notes, photos, podcasts, polls, radar, survey, top8, videos, weather]; the hub entry has name='Realm Feed', placements=['realm'] only. GET /api/widgets/available?placement=profile (17) and ?placement=home (16) BOTH exclude hub (verified) — realm-only restriction works. 15/15 pytest in test_realm_hub_widget.py pass (xml: iter59_realm_hub.xml) covering create/list/post-validation/permissions/ordering/cross-type 404. Frontend: /realms/dj → data-testid 'realm-customize' opens edit mode revealing realm-widgets-toolbar with 'realm-widgets-edit-toggle' (Done) + 'realm-widget-open-picker' (Add from Library). Picker opens with exactly 17 tiles whose data-testids match registry-picker-realm-tile-{key} for all 17 expected keys (myfeed, top8, live, videos, music, podcasts, photos, events, weather, calendar, countdown, notes, polls, survey, blog, radar, hub). The hub tile reads 'Realm Feed LARGE'. DOM scan of tile labels for /wallet|cash ?app|crypto|blockchain|banking|monetiz|marketplace|payment|\bads\b/i returned ZERO matches. registry-picker-realm-save button present. Hub widget already added previously persists across reload (realm-hub-widget-* testid renders). Posting a Thought ('TEST_iter59_hub_post_…') via realm-hub-kind-thought + realm-hub-text + realm-hub-submit appears in /realms/dj's hub immediately AND is NOT visible in /realms/gaming (scope isolation verified). Profile-picker scope: profile route did not expose a picker via stealth's own profile (no edit toggle surfaced) but DOM has zero 'registry-picker-profile-tile-hub' elements — both API and DOM confirm hub is hidden from profile placement. PART 2 (CommunityChat MessageActionMenu portal): Sent a fresh own message via community-chat-input + community-chat-send. Inline pencil/trash icons are GONE (DOM count of /community-chat-edit-|community-chat-delete-/ = 0). Tap on own community-chat-bubble-<id> opens the shared portal popup with ALL expected testids: community-chat-actions-<id>(-backdrop|-title|-close), community-chat-action-(edit|delete|cancel)-<id>, plus desktop variants community-chat-actions-<id>-desktop(-edit|-delete|-cancel|-title|-close). Portal is mounted under document.body (isPortal=true). Tapping a PEER (tfone) bubble does NOT open any action menu (mine-only gate works). Mobile (375x812 iPhone) viewport: tapping own bubble opens the sheet with rect {left:16, right:359, top:522.5, bottom:724} — fully inside vw=375, vh=812 viewport, NOT clipped, escapes chat container's overflow. Console hygiene: ZERO validateDOMNesting / button-in-button warnings, ZERO uncaught pageerrors during the full session (only ignored noise: 401/404 asset probes + pre-existing example.com/v.mp4 CORS, identical to iter 58). Items SKIPPED but covered by API or backend pytest: 'edit-input → Enter → (edited) suffix' inline-edit DOM verification (a transient click-visibility race interrupted the chained edit-input flow mid-script, but the Edit action button is wired and PATCH /api/community-chats/messages/:id is exercised by other suites); single-message Delete UI execution (the Cancel/Delete action buttons exist and the portal isPortal=true was verified; backend DELETE path covered by test_phase35_chat suite). Profile widget editor was not opened via UI because stealth's profile did not surface a widget-edit toggle in this build — verified instead by the API (placement=profile excludes hub) and direct DOM (no registry-picker-profile-tile-hub element). NO wallet/ads/marketplace/payments/crypto/banking widgets exist anywhere — picker DOM scan + API key list both confirm.
